svg.title: AF network diagnostic

body.style: margin: 0; padding: 22px; background: #0b0f14; color: #d7e0ea; font: 13px/1.55 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; overflow: auto;
body.div: Run this on the network that is failing. It reports what that network lets through, so the proxy can be pointed at something that actually connects.
